name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Dr. Stuart McGill Loaded Carries for Spine Health

steps: Stand between two matching dumbbells with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and bend your knees to pick up both dumbbells with a secure overhand grip.
Stand tall with shoulders rolled back, chest proud, and eyes forward.
Walk forward in a slow, controlled line taking short, deliberate strides.
Maintain an upright posture without leaning forward or swaying your torso from side to side.
coaching_cues: Keep your ribs pulled down and your core braced as if preparing for a punch.
Do not allow the weights to bounce against your thighs.
Breathe through your diaphragm into your braced abdominal wall.
